items.title: SPHMC actual smoothed-Gibbs q=2 initialization component

source.attribution: Fan Chen, Sinho Chewi, Jianfeng Lu and Matthew S. Zhang. ASTIS expands the conditional q=2 moment and transport calculation.

items.statement: Lemma 4.16 gives an all-q initialization bound for the actual smoothed Gibbs phase law. Its proof selects a minimizer, bounds its distance from the admissible reference point, applies Gibbs concentration and Gaussian smoothing, and couples the momenta identically. This ASTIS component proves the numerical q=2 squared-cost bound conditional on a supplied critical point; existence and all-q concentration remain open.
assumptions: Normalized C2 Hessian bounds alpha I <= Hessian U <= I with alpha>0.
Supplied critical point p and source small-gradient condition at xref.
0 <= eta <= 1, kappa=1/alpha, finite-dimensional real Borel space.

obligations.label: Derive reference-to-critical-point distance from the gradient condition
Integrate the actual Gibbs and smoothed position moments
Construct the minimizer from the source curvature assumptions (remaining)
Prove the all-q strong-log-concavity concentration input (remaining)

bindings.boundary: Only the conditional numerical q=2 initialization component; no critical-point existence, all-q source lemma, history, output accuracy or query cost.

assumption_deltas.source: The proof of Lemma 4.16 selects a minimizer of U without adding it to the theorem hypotheses.
assumption_deltas.lean: A point p with gradient U p = 0 is supplied explicitly.
assumption_deltas.reason: The Gibbs moment parent requires a stationary-point witness. Existence under the source assumptions must be formalized separately; this declaration is not source-equivalent to the unconditional lemma.

assumption_deltas.source: The source concludes for every q>=2.
assumption_deltas.lean: Only a squared M_kappa Kantorovich bound at q=2 is proved.
assumption_deltas.reason: This is a scoped proof component, not the full source conclusion.

assumption_deltas.source: The source works in R^d and positive smoothing variance.
assumption_deltas.lean: Any finite-dimensional real inner-product Borel space and eta>=0 are allowed.
assumption_deltas.reason: The identities and the zero-noise case remain valid without changing the source constant.
